body.title: gh_pr_view jsonFields extension
body.summary: Add the optional jsonFields input to gh_pr_view limited to the allowlist state, mergedAt, reviewDecision, reviews, headRefName, url, and admit those fields in its output schema; default fields and every existing result stay unchanged. Flag the s5 owner's objection path.
acceptanceChecks: gh_pr_view with jsonFields returns mergedAt, reviewDecision and reviews; without it the result is byte-identical to before
a field outside the allowlist is rejected as an input mismatch

tests.name: pr-view-fields.test.ts: gh_pr_view with jsonFields returns mergedAt, reviewDecision and reviews; the default result is unchanged; a field outside the allowlist is rejected
